Field.content:
class Field (R : Type) where
  zero    : R
  one     : R
  add     : R → R → R
  mul     : R → R → R
  opp     : R → R
  add_comm  : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)
  add_zero  : ∀ x, add x zero = x
  add_opp   : ∀ x, add x (opp x) = zero
  mul_comm  : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x
  mul_assoc : ∀ x y z, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)
  mul_one   : ∀ x, mul x one = x
  dist_l    : ∀ a x y, mul a (add x y) = add (mul a x) (mul a y)

Field.add_comm.content: add_comm  : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x

Field.add_assoc.content: add_assoc : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)

Field.add_zero.content: add_zero  : ∀ x, add x zero = x

Field.add_opp.content: add_opp   : ∀ x, add x (opp x) = zero

Field.mul_comm.content: mul_comm  : ∀ x y, mul x y = mul y x

Field.mul_assoc.content: mul_assoc : ∀ x y z, mul (mul x y) z = mul x (mul y z)

Field.mul_one.content: mul_one   : ∀ x, mul x one = x

Field.dist_l.content: dist_l    : ∀ a x y, mul a (add x y) = add (mul a x) (mul a y)

VSpace.content:
class VSpace (R : Type) [Field R] (V : Type) where
  zeroV : V
  addV  : V → V
  oppV  : V → V
  smul  : R → V → V
  addV_comm  : ∀ u v, addV u v = addV v u
  addV_assoc : ∀ u v w, addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w)
  addV_zero  : ∀ u, addV u zeroV = u
  addV_opp   : ∀ u, addV u (oppV u) = zeroV
  smul_addV  : ∀ a u v, smul a (addV u v) = addV (smul a u) (smul a v)
  addR_smul  : ∀ a b u, smul (a +R b) u = addV (smul a u) (smul b u)
  mul_smul   : ∀ a b u, smul (a *R b) u = smul a (smul b u)
  one_smul   : ∀ u, smul Field.one u = u
  smul_zero  : ∀ a, smul a zeroV = zeroV

•V.content: notation:70 a " •V " u => VSpace.smul a u

LMap.content:
structure LMap (V W : Type) [VSpace R V] [VSpace R W] where
  toFun : V → W
  map_add : ∀ u v, toFun (VSpace.addV (R:=R) u v)
             = VSpace.addV (R:=R) (toFun u) (toFun v)
  map_smul : ∀ a u, toFun (VSpace.smul (R:=R) a u)
             = VSpace.smul (R:=R) a (toFun u)

LMap.map_add.content:
map_add : ∀ u v, toFun (VSpace.addV (R:=R) u v)
             = VSpace.addV (R:=R) (toFun u) (toFun v)

LMap.map_smul.content:
map_smul : ∀ a u, toFun (VSpace.smul (R:=R) a u)
             = VSpace.smul (R:=R) a (toFun u)

variable_VSpace_instances.content: variable [VSpace R V] [VSpace R W] [VSpace R U]

ker.content: def ker (L : LMap (R:=R) V W) : V → Prop := fun x => L.toFun x = VSpace.zeroV (R:=R)

im.content: def im  (L : LMap (R:=R) V W) : W → Prop := fun y => ∃ x, L.toFun x = y

comp.content:
def comp (g : LMap (R:=R) W U) (f : LMap (R:=R) V W) : LMap (R:=R) V U :=
{ toFun := fun x => g.toFun (f.toFun x)
, map_add := by
    intro u v
    simp
, map_smul := by
    intro a u
    simp
}

ker_add.content:
theorem ker_add {L : LMap (R:=R) V W} {x y : V} :
  ker L x → ker L y → ker L (VSpace.addV (R:=R) x y) :=
by
  intro hx hy
  unfold ker at hx hy ⊢
  simp [hx, hy]

ker_smul.content:
theorem ker_smul {L : LMap (R:=R) V W} {a : R} {x : V} :
  ker L x → ker L (VSpace.smul (R:=R) a x) :=
by
  intro hx
  unfold ker at *
  simp [hx]

im_add.content:
theorem im_add {L : LMap (R:=R) V W} {y z : W} :
  im L y → im L z → im L (VSpace.addV (R:=R) y z) :=
by
  intro hy hz
  rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rcases hz with ⟨x', rfl⟩
  refine ⟨VSpace.addV (R:=R) x x', ?_⟩
  simp

im_smul.content:
theorem im_smul {L : LMap (R:=R) V W} {a : R} {y : W} :
  im L y → im L (VSpace.smul (R:=R) a y) :=
by
  intro hy; rcases hy with ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨VSpace.smul (R:=R) a x, ?_⟩
  simp

addR_opp.content: addR_opp   : forall x, addR x (oppR x) = zeroR;

mulR_comm.content: mulR_comm  : forall x y, mulR x y = mulR y x;

mulR_assoc.content: mulR_assoc : forall x y z, mulR (mulR x y) z = mulR x (mulR y z);

mulR_one.content: mulR_one   : forall x, mulR x oneR = x;

distR_l.content: distR_l    : forall a x y, mulR a (addR x y) = addR (mulR a x) (mulR a y)

addV_comm.content: addV_comm  : forall u v, addV u v = addV v u;

addV_assoc.content: addV_assoc : forall u v w, addV (addV u v) w = addV u (addV v w);

addV_zero.content: addV_zero  : forall u, addV u zeroV = u;

Lin.map_add.content: map_add  : forall u v, toFun (u +V v) = addV (toFun u) (toFun v);

Lin.map_smul.content: map_smul : forall a u, toFun (a •V u) = smul a (toFun u)

ker.content:
Definition ker `{VS1 : VSpace} `{VS2 : VSpace} (L : Lin) : V0 -> Prop :=
    fun x => toFun L x = zeroV.

im.content:
Definition im  `{VS1 : VSpace} `{VS2 : VSpace} (L : Lin) : V0 -> Prop :=
    fun y => exists x, toFun L x = y.

ker_add.content:
Lemma ker_add `{VS1 : VSpace} `{VS2 : VSpace}
    (L : Lin) (x y : V0) :
    ker L x -> ker L y -> ker L (x +V y).
  Proof.
    intros hx hy.
    unfold ker in *.
    rewrite map_add.
    rewrite hx, hy.
    now rewrite addV_zero.
  Qed.

ker_smul.content:
Lemma ker_smul `{VS1 : VSpace} `{VS2 : VSpace}
    (L : Lin) (a : R0) (x : V0) : ker L x -> ker L (a •V x).
  Proof.
    intros hx; unfold ker in *.
    now rewrite map_smul, hx, smul_zeroV.
  Qed.

im_add.content:
Lemma im_add `{VS1 : VSpace} `{VS2 : VSpace}
    (L : Lin) (y z : V0) :
    im L y -> im L z -> im L (y +V z).
  Proof.
    intros [x Hx] [x' Hx']; subst y z.
    exists (x +V x').
    now rewrite map_add.
  Qed.

im_smul.content:
Lemma im_smul `{VS1 : VSpace} `{VS2 : VSpace}
    (L : Lin) (a : R0) (y : V0) :
    im L y -> im L (a •V y).
  Proof.
    intros [x Hx]; subst y.
    exists (a •V x); now rewrite map_smul.
  Qed.
